---
modules:
  pon:
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
    metrics:
      - name: pon_cpu1_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu1_tempC }"
        help: PON CPU1 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_cpu2_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu2_tempC }"
        help: PON CPU2 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_module_voltage
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .module_voltage }"
        help: PON module voltage
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_optic_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .optic_tempC }"
        help: PON optics temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_ploam_state
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .ploam_state }"
        help: PON ploam state
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_rx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .rx_power_dBm }"
        help: PON rx power in dBm
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_tx_bias_ma
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_bias_mA }"
        help: PON tx bias in mA
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_tx_power_dba
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_power_dBm }"
        help: PON tx power in dBm
        labels:
          sensor: pon
